blogs.title: Brevo Free Plan Guide: Send 9,000 Emails Every Month
blogs.author: Jerry
blogs.content:
When you are just starting a business or a blog, every single dollar counts. You know you need email marketing, but paying a monthly fee before you have made any profit is stressful.

That is exactly why the Brevo free plan is so useful. You can send up to 9,000 emails per month, with a daily limit, without paying anything.

In this guide we look at what the free plan includes, where its limits are, and when it makes sense to upgrade.

blogs.title: Professional Email Breakdown: Core Sections and Their Purpose
blogs.author: Jerry
blogs.content:
We have all been there: a blank screen, a blinking cursor, and an important email to write.

A professional email has a few clear parts: the subject line, the greeting, the body, the call to action and the signature. Each one has a job.

In this post we go through every part and show what a good version looks like.

blogs.title: 5 Segmentation Strategies in Brevo That Increase Conversions
blogs.author: Jerry
blogs.content:
Sending the same email to your whole list is the fastest way to get ignored.

Segmentation means splitting your contacts into smaller groups, so each group gets messages that fit them.

Here are five simple segments you can build in Brevo today: new subscribers, active buyers, inactive contacts, location based groups and interest based groups.
